decision_conditions: Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate compliance with Conditions 5 and 6 of approval 25/01790/FUL. The submitted details fail to demonstrate a fully enclosed frontage to the property and do not meet the requirements of the SUDs condition. Accordingly, the submitted information is considered unacceptable and contrary to Policies CP25 and CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD45, DMD47 and DMD61 of the Development Management Document (2014).
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/01790/FUL: SuDS (5), enclosure (6) and cycle parking (7) in respect of change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (HMO-house in multiple occupation) with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage.
